name: Gooey Loader
summary: Three circles that swing side to side, merge and separate, joined by an SVG gooey filter, in any colour.
useWhen: A short wait with no known length, where a playful loader suits the product
Showing that a sync or save is running inside a small status area or button
avoidWhen: Waits of a known length where progress should be shown, so use a progress bar
Dense data screens where a quiet spinner is enough, so use the wave-spinner or a plain spinner
